_doc: M96 EYE SPEC (96px figure, palette v2/pixelize/palette.json). Source of truth for eyes/mouths/blush of masters, head stamps and animated frames. Code: v2/m96/tools/eyes.py (templates, mirror, detect, stamp, check); checker CLI v2/m96/tools/eyecheck.py. See EYE_SPEC.md.

legend.K: lash (thick: lash row + outer-corner px), cat-eye wing flick, lower-lash hint, pupil, closed-eye line
legend.@: CATCHLIGHT (rendered W): 1x2 px, iris column 2 (inset), top two iris rows; with the 1x2 K pupil at iris column 3 just right of it; same screen-space position in every eye/view/expression (iris is never mirrored)
legend.W: sclera (only where the template has it)
skin (eye box is cleared to skin first)

front_left._doc: near/left eye in screen space (outer corner = col 0, inner = col 5), 6 cols x 6 rows: gap row (lash-1, skin) + lash row + 3 iris rows + 1 empty row. FACE ROUND 2 (feminine cat-eye, illustration-measured): THICK upper lash = K lash row from the outer corner col 0 to col 4 + K at the outer corner of the first iris row (2 px thick at the outer end); CAT-EYE WING = 1 K px flick up-and-out OUTSIDE the block at wing[expr] (front_left (-1,0) = one col out, one row up from the lash end); LOWER LASH hint = 1 h px (warm dark brown, softer than K: crit r1 K read boxy) at the outer corner of the iris bottom row (col 0, row 4). IRIS (identical in every eye, never mirrored): h top row, g sides, L light bottom, K pupil 1px (iris col 3, row 3), CATCHLIGHT '@' = 1x2 W at iris col 2 rows 2-3. Row 5 outer col = '_' (keep): the SE far cheek outline K sits there (face round 2 cheek fix).

mouth._doc: 4 cols x 3 rows (cheek, mouth, jaw rows) at the anchor 'mouth' origin. m line, R open interior (no K ring), k tongue. Every mark has a same-colour 8-neighbour (qc orphan rule). Face round 2: neutral smile corners tried (crit r2: corners touch the 2px nose = moustache) -> plain .mm. line kept.

blush._doc: FACE ROUND 2: soft OVAL blush patches in k (skin blush), template rows drawn at each anchor blush [x, y, kind] (kind front = 4 wide, far = 3 wide (SE far cheek), ne = NE 1x2). Only s/S/k pixels are painted (never outline/eye/mouth); every k has a k neighbour (qc S4). Present in the neutral master (qc: stamps may not add colours absent from the master head).

ne_lash._doc: NE: only the lash tip pokes past the cheek outline (px count, stacked upward from the lash row)

rules: One construction everywhere (face round 2, measured on the illustrations): K lash row from the outer corner (col 0..4) + K outer-corner px on the first iris row = thick upper lash; cat-eye WING = 1 K px flick up-and-out outside the block (wing); LOWER-LASH hint = 1 h px (warm dark brown) at the outer corner of the iris bottom row; iris 4x3: h top, g sides, L light bottom, K pupil 1px, W catchlight 1x2 (iris col 2); no lid line / grey row under the iris (reads as eye bags).
Catchlight: 1x2 W at iris column 2, top two iris rows, pupil right next to it; identical in both eyes, all views, all expressions, mirrored frames (the iris block is never mirrored).
Eye vertical position = the illustration eye line (face_measure.json): lash row = qc crown + eye_dy[view] (S 20, SE 21, E 20).
Expressions change only lash/lid/brow rows, wing, mouth and blush; whenever the iris is visible it is this iris + catchlight.
Iris colour = the illustration's grey-brown: palette h #342126 / g #5e4a45 / L #85706a (eyes material).
Open-eye expressions keep the neutral iris + catchlight pixels exactly (qc stamps rule); closed/squint expressions (joy, blink_closed, effort, pain) drop the iris and the wing.
Brows: thin 1px g arcs (brow.char) (4-5 px; far eye 3-4 px) in rows lash-3/lash-2 with a 1-row skin gap above the lash; expression changes only their shape.

Nose: S = 2 px vertical S at the face centre-left (63, 54-55); SE = 2 px S at (71, 55-56) beside the far eye; E = profile nose bump 2 rows (K out at col 79, rows 54-55, K underside at (78,56)). NE/N none.
Blush: soft oval k patches (front 4+2 px, SE far 3+2, E one front patch, NE 1x2) under the eyes, on the illustration blush (rows lash+5, lash+6).

eye_dy._doc: lash row - qc crown (30) per view, measured on the illustration (face_measure.json): S 20 (lash 50), SE 21 (lash 51; illus near 51.5 / far 50.8), E 20 (lash 50)

kinds_by_view._doc: left-to-right in screen space; mirrored views (W/SW/NW) use mirrored kinds, the catchlight stays top-left

front_right_override._doc: hand-mirrored right eyes where the lid slope must mirror but the catchlight column may not

brow._doc: Brows (FACE_SPEC.md): 3 template rows = lash-4, lash-3, lash-2 (eye block y0-3..y0-1); row lash-1 (eye block row 0) is the skin GAP (surprised: lash raised into it, the brow is raised too). Colour = brow.char (g, hair-ramp brown; templates write h). front_left = screen-left eye, inner (toward the nose) = right end; front_right = mirror; far = SE far eye (inner = left end, x0 = far eye x0); E uses front_left. Window: over brow cols (front 1-4, far 0-3) every hair/K/m px from the row above the brow top down to lash-2 becomes skin (top row S = shade under the bangs, rest s), so the brow never touches the fringe.

wing._doc: cat-eye flick: K px OUTSIDE the 6x6 block, [dx, dy] relative to the front_left eye origin (x0, y0 = gap row). front_right: dx -> 5 - dx; far (SE far eye, 4 wide): dx -> 4 (one col right of the far block). Stamps restore the master pixel under every wing position of the other expressions (anchor eyes[i].wing_bg). Closed/squint eyes have no wing.
